# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.8 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.7:

- PDF: user and owner passwords for encrypted files (`--pdf-password`, env var, GUI field); empty password still tried.
- JBIG2: Huffman refinement and aggregation decoded natively (checked against poppler/pdfium).
- JPEG 2000: bypass, termall, reset, vertically causal, predictable termination, segmentation symbols, POC, PPM/PPT decoded natively (checked against OpenJPEG on ~1360 streams). Palette and high-throughput styles still need an external renderer.
- Dewarp: guides drawn with the mouse follow perspective; undo/redo/reset cover guides; implausible guides are ignored.
- Blank-page detection no longer drops faint pencil pages.
- Word export: column sections, RTL, table/prose heuristics. 7z and RAR archive tests added.
- Native OCR: gutter detection and junk-line filter; on 12 real Romanian pages CER 38.9 % -> 17.5 % (Tesseract 14.6 %). Still behind Tesseract.
- COMPARISON.md rewritten as a sourced comparison with commercial and open-source tools (2 Nov 2026).

Not solved: PDF/A is checked on samples, not certified; Windows/macOS/ARM builds are CI-only; GUI tested by hand on Linux only.
